name: Spathodea
bio: Archetype: ST DPT, AP-Greedy. ⌽ Insight grants additional Crit Rate after applying [Burn] and inflicts [Burn] on Crit. ⌽ S2 grants self [Preignition], additional Crit Rate and a precast S1 next turn. ⌽ S1 deals additional Crit DMG while holding [Preignition]. ⌽ Ult deals additional Crit DMG, increased when enemy holds 15+ [Burn]. ⌽ Crit-reliant damage. Low Crit Rate = low consistency. ⌽ Cannot consistently achieve Ult [Burn] conditional without [Burn] support.
